subject: The truth about what happens after 28 days
preview_text: This month's community numbers are in. What we discovered will change how you see your healing.
body_paragraphs: I just closed the analytics dashboard and my jaw is on the floor. I wasn't going to send this email, but the data from the last 28 days is too powerful to keep secret. It reveals something critical about everyone using Fresh Start right now.

This month, the community collectively logged over 47,000 no-contact streaks. That's 47,000 moments of choosing yourself over checking their social media. The average mood score jumped 62% between week one and week four. But here's the real confession: 89% of people who completed the '28-Day Reset' challenge reported feeling a fundamental shift in their identity. They stopped seeing themselves as 'someone's ex' and started building something new. The numbers don't lie—the fourth week is where the magic happens.

This is why the 'Progress Timeline' in the app is the most powerful feature you're probably not using enough. It doesn't just track your mood. It visually maps the exact moment your community's data shows people start to turn the corner. It connects your private journey to the collective proof that healing is happening, right now, for hundreds of others.

Open your Progress Timeline right now. See your own 28-day arc laid over the community's proven healing curve. Do it today, because this insight resets at midnight. P.S. The most-viewed entry in the community journal this month? 'I finally deleted their number.'
